confirm_delete_body: '{label}' will be removed for good. This cannot be undone.
confirm_trash_body: '{label}' goes to the Trash. You can restore it from there.
create_subtitle: Pick a name and a strong master password.
error_integrity: The vault file failed its integrity check: it may be damaged or altered. Restore a backup.
error_not_authenticated: You are not signed in to GitHub.
error_not_self_contained: Vault '{name}' is an older (V1) vault without embedded key parameters.
error_unsupported_version: This vault was written by a newer Lilypad. Update Lilypad to open it.
merge_ties: simultaneous edits resolved: {count} (the other version is in the safety backup)
preferences_about_desc: A local-first password manager, part of Project Colony.
preferences_auto_lock_desc: The vault locks itself after this long without activity.
preferences_breach_desc: Checks your passwords against known breaches (Have I Been Pwned). Only the first 5 characters of each password's SHA-1 hash are sent: passwords never leave this device.
preferences_clipboard_desc: A copied secret is wiped from the clipboard after this delay.
preferences_default_view_desc: The list Lilypad opens on when you unlock a vault.
preferences_density_desc: Corners, borders and shadows of cards and buttons.
preferences_export_desc: Exports this vault as a PLAINTEXT CSV with every secret in clear, for a backup or to move elsewhere. Delete the file when you are done.
preferences_github_code_desc: Authorize Lilypad in the browser tab that just opened, then enter this code:
preferences_github_signin_desc: Sign in with GitHub to keep encrypted copies of your vaults in a private repository. Only the encrypted file ever leaves this device.
preferences_import_desc: Imports from another password manager; the format is detected: LastPass, Bitwarden (CSV or JSON), KeePassXC, 1Password, Safari, Chrome and Edge, Firefox, Proton Pass, Dashlane, or a Lilypad CSV. Existing entries are never overwritten.
preferences_language_desc: The language of the interface. It changes at once.
preferences_master_desc: Encrypts every entry again under a new key. At least 8 characters.
preferences_master_locked: Unlock a vault to change its master password.
preferences_pull_desc: Pull downloads and checks the vault on GitHub, then REPLACES the one on this device with it (a safety backup is kept). It uses the master password entered in the Sync section; the app locks after a pull.
preferences_push_desc: Push uploads the encrypted vault. It refuses to overwrite a vault on GitHub that changed since your last sync.
preferences_reopen_last_vault_desc: Selects the vault you used last on the unlock screen.
preferences_security_desc: Protect what is in your vault.
preferences_storage_desc: Where Lilypad keeps your files, readable only by your account.
preferences_sync_desc: Back your vaults up to a private GitHub repository.
preferences_sync_now_desc: Merges the vault on GitHub into this one, entry by entry: the newest version of each entry wins, deletions and renames carry over, and the merged vault is pushed back when GitHub misses local changes. Works from any state, conflicts included. A safety backup is kept and the app locks during the sync.
preferences_sync_password: Master password (used by Sync and Pull)
preferences_tip_favorite: Click the star to add an entry to your favorites.
preferences_tip_quick_copy: Hover a list row to copy its username, password or TOTP in one click.
preferences_tip_reveal: Hold the password field to reveal it while pressed.
preferences_tip_trash: Deleting moves an entry to the Trash first; delete it there to remove it for good.
preferences_vault_desc: What is inside and where it lives.
preferences_vaults_locked: Unlock a vault to see its contents and health.
status_auto_lock_set: The vault now locks after {minutes} min of inactivity.
status_breach_checking: Checking against Have I Been Pwned…
status_breach_found: Found in a breach: {count} of your entries. Change their passwords.
status_breach_none: Breach check: no password found in a breach ({count} checked).
status_clipboard_unavailable: The clipboard is not available (install wl-copy or xclip).
status_export_path_needed: Enter where to save the CSV export.
status_exported: Exported a PLAINTEXT CSV to {path}. Keep it safe and delete it when you are done.
status_import_delete_source: Delete the source file once you have checked them.
status_import_path_needed: Enter the path of the exported file.
status_master_too_short: The master password needs at least 8 characters.
status_no_remote: There is no vault with this name on GitHub.
status_no_remote_push_first: There is no vault with this name on GitHub. Push first to create it.
status_no_totp: This entry has no TOTP secret.
status_pull_password_needed: Enter the master password in Preferences > Sync to check the pulled vault.
status_pulled: Pulled from GitHub. Unlock to open the updated vault.
status_sync_password_needed: Enter the master password in Preferences > Sync to sync.
status_sync_running: A sync is running. Unlock when it finishes.
status_synced: Synced '{vault}': {summary}. Unlock to open the merged vault.
status_synced_pushed: Synced '{vault}': {summary}, then pushed back. Unlock to open the merged vault.
sync_conflict_hint: Both sides changed. Sync combines them entry by entry and keeps a safety backup.
sync_no_baseline_hint: Push or pull once to start.
sync_remote_ahead_hint: Pull or sync to get the latest.
sync_unknown_hint: Check the status to compare with GitHub.
tui_create_help: Tab switches field, Enter creates the vault.
tui_help:
Navigation
  j/k or ↑/↓   move
  Enter or v   view the entry
  /            search

 Actions
  a  add an entry     e  edit the entry
  d  to the Trash     T  open the Trash
  g  generate         l  lock the vault
  c  copy password    u  copy username
  t  copy TOTP

 Trash
  r  restore          x  delete for good

  q / Esc  quit
tui_hint_confirm: y confirm · any other key cancels
tui_hint_confirm_purge: y delete FOR GOOD · any other key cancels
tui_hint_create: Tab switch field · Enter create · Esc back
tui_hint_form: Tab next · Ctrl+Enter save · Esc cancel
tui_hint_generate: r regenerate · +/- length · U/L/D/S toggle sets · c copy · Esc back
tui_hint_list: a add · e edit · d delete · Enter view · c/u/t copy · / search · g generate · T trash · l lock · ? help · q quit
tui_hint_locked: type the password · ↑↓ vault · Enter unlock · ^N new vault · Esc quit
tui_hint_search: type to filter · Enter done · Esc clear
tui_hint_trash: r restore · x delete for good · ↑↓ move · Esc back
tui_hint_view: p show/hide · c copy password · u copy username · t copy TOTP · Esc back
tui_yes_no: y = yes, any other key = no
unlock_subtitle: Enter the master password of this vault.
